headword: {酒酔|しゅよ}い{運転|うんてん}
gloss: drunk driving; driving under the influence

definitions.gloss: drunk driving; driving under the influence
definitions.explanation: the act of operating a vehicle while impaired by alcohol, a serious criminal offense in Japan

notes:
A legal term combining {酒酔|しゅよ}い (intoxication) and ⟦{運転|うんてん}→運転：01335_unten⟧ (driving). In Japanese traffic law, this is the more serious category of alcohol-impaired driving, where the driver is visibly intoxicated and unable to drive normally. Japan has extremely strict drunk driving laws, with severe penalties including imprisonment.
